note: Campground on TVA's Watts Bar Lake and a charter member of TVA's Camp-Right program; every site is on or looks over the lake, and 18 sites have only 30/20-amp service. A gated boat ramp, boat slips ($10 a night), two swimming beaches, propane, live bait and kayak, canoe, paddleboard and paddle-boat rentals ($25-35 a day); pump-out at the site costs $30-45. --Claude
summary: Private, Watts Bar Lake (TVA). Rates confirmed (operator page + Campspot 2027-01-26): $44-60, cheapest RV night $44 Sun-Thu (under the $50 gate). 109 sites, 50A/water, no sewer (pump-out service), all back-in to 50 ft. Lakefront KEPT: Campspot sells 26 'Waterfront' sites (005, 007, 015, 019, 021, 022, 026-029 among them) with pads 6-15 m from the high-water line. Long-stay tests pass (65 of 109 sites sold nightly on Campspot, ~60%; Google 4.7/227). Pin, phone, website unchanged.
flags: WATERFRONT kept (lakefront): Campspot's 'Waterfront' type (26 sites; 005, 007, 015, 019, 021, 022, 026, 027, 028, 029 open on 2027-01-26) matches the perimeter loop on the park's site map; on Esri imagery perimeter pads sit ~6-15 m from the vegetated high-water edge (~35.69245,-84.70416 and ~35.69136,-84.70425). The park's photos show gravel pads at water level with open trunks between them and the lake, not a tree line. Winter-drawdown imagery was measured to the vegetation line.
PRICE GATE passes: the cheapest RV night is $44 (non-waterfront, Sunday to Thursday) before the $10.50 Campspot surcharge.
LONG-STAY passes: the park offers April-October seasonal camping, but Campspot sells 65 of 109 sites by the night (~60%); no wording discourages nightly guests. Google 4.7 (227 reviews).
PIN left at 35.69016,-84.70617 (office/entrance junction); the sites spread ~150-400 m north and west over two lobes, centroid ~35.692,-84.707 (~210 m).
